With the drain enabled, enqueue behavior is unchanged (existing tests still pass).

citation.description: The fix only adds a guard in sign_plan_review (attest.py) to skip the enqueue call when overlap_drain is off. No code touches existing queue event files. The test at line 137-156 only asserts no NEW event is written; it does not delete or modify existing events. The ticket comment confirms 'Historical queue events stay untouched (read-only history; no backlog drain, no deletion)'.
